<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generate.mjs — do not edit by hand. Source: commands/add-skill.md -->


Add a skill to an existing plugin. Steps:

1. Determine the target plugin and skill name (kebab-case) from `${input:arguments}`, asking if unclear.
2. Create `plugins/<plugin>/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md` with YAML frontmatter:
   - `name`: the skill name (must match the directory name)
   - `description`: a precise, trigger-oriented description (when should this skill activate?)
   - add `disable-model-invocation: true` only if it is a user-invoked entry point.
3. Write the skill body as direct, imperative instructions to the model.
4. If the skill is vendored from a third party, STOP and follow the vendoring rules in
   `CLAUDE.md`: co-locate a `LICENSE`, add an attribution header comment, mark any
   modifications, and add an entry to `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`. Never relicense others' work.
5. Run `node scripts/generate.mjs` and bump the plugin version via a conventional commit
   (`feat(<plugin>): add <skill> skill`).
